headlines.text: It was 2025 when Konosuke Takeshita vs. Jon Moxley met in a Continental Classic League Match, in the night's main event on Collision, rated 8.59 ? a stone-cold classic. In a match focused entirely on Moxley's knee, Takeshita used dragon screws and the steel steps before a Blue Thunder Bomb through the commentary table and a second Raging Fire driver sealed his Continental Classic win, handing Moxley his second loss of the tournament.

On a Wednesday in 2023, back when Christian Cage vs. Adam Copeland clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.91. It was the first title opportunity of Adam Copeland's career. It was the 80th time the AEW TNT Title had been on the line, a real piece of championship history. Nick Wayne's mother blindsided Copeland with the TNT Title belt, letting Christian steal the win with the Killswitch in the first-ever singles meeting between the former tag partners in 13 years.
That Friday in 2024, Ricochet vs. Komander met in a Continental Classic League Match, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 7.58 ? a strong outing.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2023, when Swerve Strickland vs. Mark Briscoe met in a Continental Classic League Match on Dynamite, rated 8.01 ? an excellent showing.
